svg.title: Double-pendulum finite-time operational atlas
svg.desc: Cell-centred initial-angle torus coloured by grid-edge finite-time operational log-stretch. White circles mark the separately declared low-stretch, no-sampled-full-turn mask.
svg.text: Grid-edge log-stretch; circles mark resolved cells with no sampled full turn
